whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Purple Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has strong 3.9★ reviews with 270+ happy patrons on SP Verma Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu browsing.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, signature menu highlights, aur Google map directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/purplecafe

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Purple Cafe Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Purple Cafe) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a mobile-first menu showcase and direct WhatsApp table reservation for your SP Verma Road location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual cafe photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
